## Checklist

- [ ] I read the [contribution guide](https://github.com/BasaltProject/Proxy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/BasaltProject/Proxy/blob/main/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] The change is focused and follows the repository's style.
- [ ] Behavior changes have relevant tests, or I explained why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] I listed the checks actually run and any gaps in verification.
- [ ] Public behavior, configuration and compatibility changes are documented where applicable.
- [ ] There are no plugin-specific workarounds, secrets, private data or proprietary assets in this change.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute the submitted material under this repository's license.
